name: Hangzhou Tongshifu Cultural and Creative (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Tongshifu Cultural and Creative (Group) Co., Ltd. designs, produces and sells creative cultural items made of copper. Product series draw on traditional culture, auspicious homophones, relic revival and folklore. Sales run through direct selling, distributors, online partners and consignment, under the TONGSHIFU, TAITONG and HAPPY GENERAL brands.
